page.layout: One page of verse, one column, with running head at top. Page number "18" at top left. No notes. A marginal mark "Iö" stands at the right edge beside the last line.

p.i: Auro, non minus ac cuspidibus, rates:
Vitæ non aliter prodiga, quàm foret
Per deserta Tygris, dum repetit suos
Fœtus è medijs ignibus, haud memor
Sed bellator adest jam DEVS agmini
Ferro, vndis, hominum qui geneti graueis
Arctoa requiem sub niue sic habent
Et quos dura sitis non satiabiles
Jö, Christe DEVS, Christe DEVS, DEVS!

page.notes: Verse lines are separated by line breaks within each stanza. The marginal "Iö" at the right edge is printed beside the final line. Printed spellings such as "geneti", "Caspia", "Hispali" and "Christe" are left as printed. The long s has been written as plain s. Some lines show show-through at the page edge, which is not transcribed.
